official_android_prepare_for_release: The signing key is present, its validity runs beyond 2033-10-22, and the release APK is signed with it (verified by fingerprint).
applicationId is unchanged from the previous release.
debuggable is disabled in the release build type.
versionCode is incremented and versionName is updated.
The manifest permissions are minimal, and android:icon and android:label are set.
No stray files: src/ has no jars, lib/ has no test libraries, there are no unused resources, and no leftover private data files.
Remote server and service URLs are production URLs, not test URLs.
The release build is tested on a real device (phone-size at minimum) under real conditions.
project_specific: The version string is identical in all four places: android/app/build.gradle (versionCode and versionName), pyproject.toml, src/version.py and android/README.md.
The full pytest suite is green.
No signing material is tracked: no *.jks, *.keystore or keystore.properties under android/.
The release-note template exists in docs/ and carries the signing_model and migration_flow sections, with no wording that normalises update data loss.
The APK is built by the android-release workflow (tag-triggered) and its fingerprint guard step has PASSED.
Release assets are attached: the signed APK and its .sha256 checksum file.
github_release_conventions: The tag is named vX.Y.Z-release (project convention).
The release title is exactly 'DK Bond Tracker vX.Y.Z' (project convention).
The release body starts with the migration warning for debug-era users when applicable, then the New and Changed sections with issue links, then the Full Changelog link.
The release is marked as the latest release.

usage: Run sh scripts/release-checklist.sh X.Y.Z before publishing. It automates the locally checkable items (version consistency, release-note template, no tracked signing material, tag-only release workflow, no data-loss wording) and prints ALL GREEN or one 'release-checklist: FAIL <item>' line per failure. The remaining items need a built APK, CI or a GitHub release and are checked by hand.
